descriptions.w3d_d25b_corner_tint_80086324: Corner tint selection: reads eight colour components from the records at +388 and +392 at the byte offsets 0x804addec to 0x804ade08 into the corner sets 0x804ada74 and 0x804ada94, sets 0x7f00 on the corners whose flag words +656, +664, +660, +668 have bit 2 and then bit 1 set, and stores the averaged rows in 0x804adb28 and 0x804adb30.
